label_zh: 非正式實驗世界／不屬於正式遊戲歷史
principle: Everything that can affect the future is saved. Data may be omitted only if it is rebuilt deterministically from saved data AND a test proves the rebuilt state is identical (listed under rebuildable with that test). Loading never resamples fates.

physics_chemistry.note: Required only once the Worker simulates these; never fabricated before.

boundary: Snapshots only at consistent event boundaries: no half trophallaxis, half predation, open carry or open food transfer; ledgers balance at that instant. Checked by the Worker before it emits (SAVE-2).
